title: AI voice-clone Biden robocalls (New Hampshire primary)
summary: Two days before the January 2024 New Hampshire primary, voters received robocalls with an AI-generated voice imitating President Biden, spoofed to look as if they came from a prominent local Democrat. Political consultant Steve Kramer admitted creating the calls. Lingo Telecom, which carried them, agreed in August 2024 to a $1 million FCC fine and stronger caller-verification (STIR/SHAKEN) procedures, and in September 2024 the FCC fined Kramer $6 million. In June 2025 a New Hampshire jury found Kramer not guilty of state voter-suppression and candidate-impersonation charges. The case is included because it shows how convincing a cloned voice on a phone call can be.
